context_requirements: Expression of nicotinic acetylcholine receptors (e.g., CHRNA7) for canonical signaling
Neuronal or neuroendocrine lineage for robust transcriptional responses
Presence of specific nicotine-metabolizing enzymes to generate active metabolites
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
Activation of known nicotine-responsive pathways (e.g., immediate early genes, NF-kB) in these lines
Significant overlap of the transcriptional signature with that of nicotine or other nicotinic agonists
